risk_note: RV2 (union; order ownership path). D10-793 ① (FU-TB-ARCHIVE-FOREIGN-RIGHTS, punishment half): the archive (union_raw_payloads) of 大淘客 get-foul-order-list requests stores the page with other companies' promotion-slot rows removed, same as B1-04zzc plan A (D10-778). listPunishments now passes taobaoPunishArchiveBody as archiveBody: rows of data.results whose tk_adzone_id is readable (same punishAdzone reading as ourPunishRows) and not among our slots are dropped; unreadable rows, our rows (retired included), every outer member (total_count unchanged) and JSON number literals are kept; nothing to drop or a non-list results returns the body unchanged; a body that is not JSON throws and the existing archive wrapper stores an empty payload with error_code. Refunds (no slot field) are untouched and wait for the orchestrator's ruling (B1-04zzq). Items, nextCursor and the per-page taobao_punish_foreign_slot warning are unchanged. Frozen [AC-B1-04zzc#12] (punishment archive was the raw body) changed per D10-327 to the new expectation only. No amount change.

reviews.note: Codex usage exhausted until 11-11 (D10-775): money review by a fresh independent Claude via tools/agent/claude-run.sh, round 1 pass with no findings.

The reviewer confirmed others.test.ts changes only header comment lines 1-3 and the title and body of #12; #11, #13, #14 are character-for-character unchanged (the ledger's red_exempt).
